children: Apogee Enterprises entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Alzette, the parent of Latvia-based Groglass, for approximately €62.5 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis. The deal includes up to €10 million of contingent consideration tied to three-year performance targets. Apogee plans to fund the transaction with cash on hand and borrowings under its existing credit facility. Closing is subject to customary conditions and is expected in the third quarter of fiscal 2027.
